agent-submission.objective: Map d-dimensional quantum bulk to (d-1)-dimensional boundary encoding. Formalize AdS/CFT correspondence as relational bijection. Generate holographic fact projections for lower-dimensional representation.

inputs.input: Bulk space: d dimensions, metric ds² = gμν dxμ dxν, scalar curvature R
Boundary CFT: (d-1) dimensions, central charge c, conformal dimension Δ

facts.fact: bulk_point(X, Coords, Metric, Curvature) :- coordinates(X, Coords), metric(Coords, Metric), ricci_scalar(Metric, Curvature)
boundary_operator(O, Dimension, Coupling) :- operator(O), conformal_dim(O, Dimension), coupling_constant(O, Coupling)
holographic_map(BulkField, BoundaryOperator, Coupling) :- bulk_field(BulkField), boundary_operator(BoundaryOperator, _, C), Coupling = C

rule.head: rg_flow(Operator, Scale, ScaledOp)
rule.body: boundary_operator(Operator, Dim, Coupling), radial_scale(Scale, LogScale), scaled_dimension(Dim, LogScale, ScaledDim), beta_function(Coupling, BetaCoupling), ScaledOp = operator(ScaledDim, BetaCoupling)

rule.head: conformal_block(Op1, Op2, Op3, Block)
rule.body: boundary_operator(Op1, D1, _), boundary_operator(Op2, D2, _), boundary_operator(Op3, D3, _), compute_block(D1, D2, D3, Block)

rule.head: entanglement_entropy(Region, BoundaryEntropy, BulkArea)
rule.body: conformal_region(Region, BoundaryRegion), area_law(BoundaryRegion, BoundaryEntropy), minimal_surface(Region, Surface), ryu_takayanagi(Surface, BulkArea), BoundaryEntropy =:= BulkArea / (4 * GNewton)

rule.head: correlation(Op1, Op2, Op3, Op4, CorrFunc)
rule.body: boundary_operator(Op1, D1, _), boundary_operator(Op2, D2, _), boundary_operator(Op3, D3, _), boundary_operator(Op4, D4, _), conformal_block(Op1, Op2, Op34, Block34), conformal_block(Op3, Op4, Op34, Block34_alt), merge_blocks(Block34, Block34_alt, CorrFunc)

constraints.constraint: :- rg_flow(Op, S1, Op1), rg_flow(Op, S2, Op2), S1 < S2, Dim1 is dimension(Op1), Dim2 is dimension(Op2), Dim1 > Dim2, Dim1 - Dim2 > 0.
:- entanglement_entropy(Region, BoundaryEnt, BulkArea), BoundaryEnt \= BulkArea / (4 * GNewton).

proof-obligations.obligation: Holographic map must be bijective between bulk fields and boundary operators.
Entanglement entropy equals (1/4) times minimal surface area in Planck units.
Boundary CFT must remain conformal invariant under radial scaling.

kernel-candidates.kernel: ads_metric(Z, Theta, Phi, [[-Z^(-2), 0, 0], [0, Z^(-2), 0], [0, 0, Z^(-2) * sin(Theta)^2]]) :- Z > 0, Theta >= 0, Theta =< pi, Phi >= 0, Phi < 2*pi.
cft_correlator(X1, X2, X3, X4, Corr) :- distance(X1, X2, D12), distance(X3, X4, D34), distance(X1, X3, D13), distance(X1, X4, D14), Corr is 1 / (D12 * D34) * f(D13, D14).
rt_surface(BoundaryRegion, Surface, Area) :- boundary_region(BoundaryRegion, Boundary), minimal_surface_in_ads(Boundary, Surface), compute_area(Surface, Area).
radial_map(BulkField, Radius, BoundaryField) :- bulk_field(BulkField, Coords, Value), extract_radius(Coords, Radius), limit(Radius, 0, BoundaryValue), BoundaryField = boundary_field(BoundaryValue).
